statement: let bump := fun (a b t : ℝ) => if a < t ∧ t < b then Real.exp (-1/((t-a)*(b-t))) else 0; let W := bump 1 (51/50); let b := bump (-1/40) (1/40); let K := fun (v : ℝ) => ∫ u : ℝ, b u * b (v-u); let H := fun (v : ℝ) => K v / 2 - K (v-1/5)/4 - K (v+1/5)/4; let k := fun (t : ℝ) => ∫ v : ℝ, b v * Real.cos (2*Real.pi*v*t); let l := fun (t : ℝ) => Real.sin (Real.pi*t/5)*k t; let T := fun (X : ℕ) => 2*Real.pi*(X:ℝ); let w := fun (X : ℕ) => (Finset.range (2*X+1)).filter (fun n => X < n ∧ 50*n < 51*X); let u := fun (X n : ℕ) => ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n * W ((n:ℝ)/X) / Real.sqrt n; let P := fun (X : ℕ) (t : ℝ) => (w X).sum (fun n => (u X n : ℂ)*Complex.exp (-Complex.I*(t:ℂ)*(Real.log n : ℂ))); let I := fun (X : ℕ) (σ : ℝ) => ∫ t in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), (l (t/T X))^2*(1+σ*Real.cos (4*Real.pi*t/T X))*‖P X t‖^2; let f := fun (x n j : ℝ) => x * Real.log (1+j/n); ∀ X : ℕ, 1000 ≤ X → I X 1 - I X (-1) = T X * ((w X).filter (fun n => n+2 ∈ w X)).sum (fun n => u X n*u X (n+2)*H (f X n 2 - 2))
